type.title: CIT type
type.description: Selects which CIT effect type this properties file describes.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Chooses the winning CIT when multiple files match the same item.

items.title: Items
items.description: Requires the item to match one of the listed item ids.

stackSize.title: Stack size
stackSize.description: Requires the item stack size to match an integer or integer range.

damage.title: Damage
damage.description: Requires the item damage to match an integer, range, percentage, or percentage range.

damageMask.title: Damage mask
damageMask.description: Applies a binary mask to item damage before matching damage.

hand.title: Hand
hand.description: Requires the item to be held in the main hand or off hand.

enchantments.title: Enchantments
enchantments.description: Requires the item to have at least one of the listed enchantment ids.

enchantmentLevels.title: Enchantment levels
enchantmentLevels.description: Requires an enchantment level to match one of the listed levels or ranges.

nbt.*.title: NBT match
nbt.*.description: Matches the specified NBT path against a literal, pattern, or regular expression.
